messages:
ashley: FinLedger (finledger-prod) opened an incident — billing console 403. They say this started after yesterday's RBAC/roles refactor. Service account impersonation failing for the billing SA. Can we triage?

maria: Thanks. Do we have a repro or an error payload? Any KMS audit entries?

ashley: Pasted customer log snippet from their browser devtools and our proxy: 
```
POST /v1/projects/finledger-prod/accounts:impersonate 403
{"error":"permission_denied","message":"Service account sa-billing@finledger-prod not authorized to use key projects/redwood-sec/locations/global/keyRings/ring-1/cryptoKeys/enc-1"}
```

alex: I pulled IAM/KMS audit logs for that tenant. See this entry from the key audit: 
```
protoPayload.serviceName: "cloudkms.googleapis.com"
protoPayload.methodName: "Encrypt"
protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail: "sa-billing@finledger-prod"
protoPayload.status.code: 7
resourceName: "projects/redwood-sec/locations/global/keyRings/ring-1/cryptoKeys/enc-1/cryptoKeyVersions/1"
"denyReason": "principalNotPermittedByKeyPolicy"
```

oncall-sre: deploy-bot rolled rbac/2026-03-18-roles-refactor at 03:22 UTC across prod namespaces. That rollout included a tightened KMS principal filter.

maria: We tightened KMS key policy to restrict cross-tenant SAs (security req), but looks like we missed adding the delegated billing SA mapping for finledger-prod. Likely caused the deny.

ashley: Customer is asking for ETA — they are blocked on invoices.

maria: Plan: add explicit principal entry for `serviceAccount:sa-billing@finledger-prod` on the key policy and patch the policy document. Will validate via staging first. Estimated < 30m.

alex: Preparing policy patch now. Patch id: keypatch-4962. Proposed change: 
```
- principals: ["serviceAccount:billing-proxy@redwood-prod"]
+ principals: ["serviceAccount:billing-proxy@redwood-prod", "serviceAccount:sa-billing@finledger-prod"]
```
Also adding a conditional on `request.time < 2027-01-01T00:00:00Z` for emergency rollback window.

deploy-bot: initiating key policy update keypatch-4962 -> projects/redwood-sec/locations/global/keyRings/ring-1/cryptoKeys/enc-1

alex: Patch applied to prod key ring, propagating. KMS console shows new principal.

maria: Re-checking KMS logs for success -- running a quick encrypt call as the SA via our impersonation test harness.

maria: Test harness result: Encrypt -> 0 OK entries in log. Audit shows methodName Encrypt, status OK.

ashley: Asked the customer to retry impersonation and billing console. Waiting for confirmation.

finledger (via ashley): Confirmed — billing console loads, invoices visible. Impersonation calls succeed. Customer: "Thanks, saved our billing cycle" :tada:

maria: Root cause: RBAC refactor tightened KMS key principals but mapping table missing delegated tenant SA for billing.

alex: Follow-up actions: 1) Add regression test that simulates delegated SA decrypt/encrypt for billing flows. 2) Add mapping validation to rollout job so missing tenant delegations fail the deploy. 3) Run a scan across registered tenants for missing KMS bindings.

oncall-sre: Also filed incident ticket INC-2026-218 and scheduled a postmortem sync for 2026-03-19 16:00 UTC.

ashley: Customer happy, closing the support escalation after follow-ups.

maria: I'll own the postmortem write-up and remediation PR. Adding labels: security, rbac, kms, customer-impact.

alex: Nice quick turnaround everyone.
